_comment: Cost-center groups for the opt-in metering module (docs/METERING.md). Each entry gets a Bedrock (mantle) Project named owui-metering-<group>; the gateway interceptor maps the caller's cognito:groups to these projects and injects the attribution header per request. Users in none of these groups attribute to the catch-all 'unassigned' project. Group names must match Cognito group names. Order matters: the FIRST matching group is the user's billing group.
